contract: DELETE /api/share/mediaitem/:id. Admin deletes a share with 204, closes its share sessions and emits share_closed; old cookies cannot access a recreated share of the same slug.
exceptions: force is not applicable: no share management or public consumer route has a force, hard or refresh/override mode.

invariants.contract: DELETE /api/share/mediaitem/:id is admin-only: an unauthenticated caller gets 401 and a non-admin 403 before any lookup, and an unknown id as admin gets 404. Success answers 204 with no body, deletes the mediaItemShares row, closes every open share playback session for it (the old cookie's slug, track, cover and download routes deny with 404) and emits share_closed to admin sockets only. Recreating the deleted slug gets a new share id; the old cookie's session stays closed until the recreated slug is opened again, which binds the same cookie to a new playback session.
exceptions: A refused delete (non-admin, unauthenticated or unknown id) changes no row, keeps the public share open and emits no share_closed.
